newsitem.title: USA: Host Marriott sees $5.5 mln EBITA for hotel.
newsitem.headline: Host Marriott sees $5.5 mln EBITA for hotel.

text.p: Host Marriott Corp said on Monday that a hotel it had acquired in a joint venture with Interstate Hotels Co was expected to report roughly $5.5 million of earnings before interest expense, taxes, depreciation and amortization for its first 12 months of operations.
Host Marriott owns a controlling interest in the hotel, called the Manhattan Beach Radisson Plaza, which it purchased in a joint venture with Interstate for $38.25 million.
The property will immediately be converted to a Marriott, Host Marriott said in a statement.

"We expect to see strong improvements in overall operating results once the hotel is converted to a Marriott," said Christopher Nassetta, chief operating officer of Host Marriott. He added that the acquisition represented Host Marriott's second joint venture with Interstate this year and its second conversion to the Marriott brand in 1997.
